Leah (docs): quick FYI — did a tiny smokecheck over the handbook UX pages (runtime/dedicated). Found a few broken breadcrumbs and one image 403 on /runtime/quickstart. Who owns the runtime quickstart images right now?
Tom (runtime): I can take the image 403. do you have the path?
Leah (docs): path is /assets/runtime/quickstart/setup.png — renders 403 in staging and the handbook anchor "/runtime/quickstart#step-2" scrolls to top instead of the step. curl shows 403 from our CDN: `curl -I https://docs.redwood.ai/assets/runtime/quickstart/setup.png`
Sofia (eng-dx): thanks — ran the scan with the lightweight link-checker, looks like the origin S3 link is fine but CloudFront returns 403 when referer header present. possible ACL or shortlink token issue.
docs-bot: automated link-scan result: 
  - runtime/quickstart: 1 image 403, 1 orphan anchor
  - dedicated/overview: 2 breadcrumb inconsistencies
  - severity: low (docs-visible), recommended: short PR + redeploy
Eli (product): heads-up: changing the quickstart snippet in runtime next sprint. if Tom is patching the image, can we coordinate so we don't flip the example while product lands?
Tom (runtime): noted. I'll pick up the 403 and the anchor in one PR. plan: 1) reupload the image to staging bucket with public-read, 2) update handbook link to canonical slug (avoid anchor id drift), 3) include a tiny redirect rule for old anchors. should be a small PR.
Leah (docs): beautiful — leave the PR link here when ready. also quick ask: can we add a one-liner in the runtime quickstart about expected image sizes to avoid future reuploads that trigger CDN resizing rules?
Sofia (eng-dx): yes, add `<!-- asset-guidelines: max-1200x800, webp preferred -->` near the image block. that'll help scans detect non-conforming assets.
Tom (runtime): wilco. I'll prep the PR later today. patch plan in draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/??? (I'll replace with real number).
Eli (product): tagging weekly docs sprint — @Leah can you add this to the sprint board so someone can QA after deploy?
Leah (docs): added to sprint board under "docs: link fixes" and assigned QA to Sofia. ETA for merge: EOD today if nothing blocks.
Sofia (eng-dx): quick check for reviewers: please sanity-run `curl -I` and open staging page in incognito to confirm CDN headers. small checklist in PR description helps.
Tom (runtime): will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
Leah (docs): thanks! ping here when merged and I'll roll the handbook bump.
